payload.title: Source icons: find the real icon on the server instead of guessing /favicon.ico
payload.description: Live newsroom showed blank white logo tiles: brookings.edu/favicon.ico is a fully transparent 16x16 placeholder, cacm.acm.org refuses outside requests. Fix: /api/newsroom/source-icon reads the home page's <link rel=icon> tags (touch icon, then largest), passes the image through, falls back to /favicon.ico only above a placeholder size, letter mark otherwise. SSRF-guarded via fetchPublic.
